message.content: In their conversations, Jennifer suggests several additional forms of exercise that Li Hua can incorporate into his routine to enhance his overall fitness. Initially, Jennifer recommends yoga and dynamic stretching techniques to improve flexibility and balance. Later, she suggests bodyweight squats, plank holds, push-ups, lunges, and glute bridges to augment his strength training. Additionally, Jennifer encourages Li Hua to include more resistance training into his routine to further boost his strength and incorporates yoga or stretching sessions for increased flexibility. Through these discussions, it becomes evident that Li Hua is open to trying various forms of exercise beyond his current routine, including yoga, dynamic stretching, and strength training exercises like squats, planks, push-ups, lunges, and glute bridges.
